title: Joyful Toddler Girl with Raised Arms on Porch Steps, 1950s Snapshot Photo
description: An endearing black-and-white snapshot of a cheerful young toddler girl standing proudly on concrete porch steps in the bright sunshine with both arms outstretched in the air. She wears a classic mid-century gathered smocked dress, ruffled bloomers, folded white socks, and white hard-soled infant walking shoes. Behind her sits the wooden plank porch and clapboard siding of a family home, exemplifying everyday domestic life in post-war mid-century America.
